caption: How the learning policies spread their choices over the six operator pairs during a run (mean over all read sets). Roulette: its weights; epsilon-greedy: epsilon/6 plus the greedy arm; UCB1: the arm it would pick next (one-hot), so the mean shows how often each arm leads. UCB1 with lowest-index ties collapses onto the first arm once rewards are all zero (D-046); with random ties (rightmost) it does not.
